be observed in the wild.

shards with its six tails and sprays

covered in snow and is revered as a
deity incarnate.

covered in snow and is revered as a
deity incarnate.

Il vit sur des montagnes
toujours couvertes de neige

It pokes them out of its burrow to
monitor its surroundings.

Its golden hairs function as sensors.
It pokes them out of its burrow to
monitor its surroundings.

Ses poils dorés servent de
capteurs. Il les sort de son terrier
pour surveiller les alentours.

original_text:
Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so
it's not very fast, but it has the
power to dig through bedrock.

Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so
it's not very fast, but it has the
power to dig through bedrock.

Ses moustaches métalliques
sont lourdes, donc il est lent,
mais il peut creuser la roche mère.

original_text:
It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle.
It's very popular with Trainers who
like giving it the attention it needs.

It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle.

Il est impulsif, égoïste
et changeant. Il plaît aux Dresseurs
qui lui donnent toute l'attention.

original_text:
These daring Pokémon have coins on
their foreheads. Darker coins are harder,
and harder coins garner more respect.
spanish_text:
These daring Pokémon have coins on
their foreheads. Darker coins are harder,
and harder coins garner more respect.

Ces Pokémon hardis ont des pièces
sur le front. Les plus sombres sont
plus dures et gagnent du respect.

original_text:
It has the classiest coat. The rippling
of its fur in the heat of battle has a
beauty all its own.

It has the classiest coat. The rippling
of its fur in the heat of battle has a
beauty all its own.

Il a le pelage
le plus chic. Ses ondulations en
plein combat ont une beauté unique.

original_text:
Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand
attaches firmly to the portions of its
body that are particularly magnetic.
spanish_text:
Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand
attaches firmly to the portions of its
body that are particularly magnetic.

Son corps est une pierre
aimantée. Le sable de fer s'y colle
sur les zones les plus aimantées.

original_text:
Graveler's entire body is tinged with
electricity due to the stones it likes
to eat. It's very quick-tempered.
spanish_text:
Graveler's entire body is tinged with
electricity due to the stones it likes
to eat. It's very quick-tempered.

Le corps de Gravalanch est
teinté d'électricité par les pierres
qu'il mange. Il est très irritable.

original_text:
Since it can't fire boulders at a rapid
pace, it's been known to seize nearby
Geodude and fire them from its back.
spanish_text:
Since it can't fire boulders at a rapid
pace, it's been known to seize nearby
Geodude and fire them from its back.

Comme il ne lance pas vite les
rochers, il attrape des Racaillou
et les projette depuis son dos.

original_text:
Its small horn hides a healing power.
With a few rubs from this its horn, any
slight wound you have will be healed.
spanish_text:
Its small horn hides a healing power.
With a few rubs from this its horn, any
slight wound you have will be healed.

Sa petite corne cache un pouvoir
de guérison. Quelques frottements
soignent la moindre blessure.

original_text:
Brave and prideful, it dashes airily
through the forest, its steps aided by
psychic powers stored in its fetlocks.
spanish_text:
Brave and prideful, it dashes airily
through the forest, its steps aided by
psychic powers stored in its fetlocks.

Courageux et fier, il
traverse la forêt, ses pas aidés par
des pouvoirs psy dans ses paturons.

original_text:
Because it eats the seeds of a plant
that grows only in Galar, their tails have
developed a spicy flavor.
spanish_text:
Because it eats the seeds of a plant
that grows only in Galar, their tails have
developed a spicy flavor.
translation:
Comme il mange
des graines d'une plante propre
à Galar, sa queue a un goût épicé.

original_text:
A Shellder bite set off a chemical
reaction with the spices inside its body,
causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type.
spanish_text:
A Shellder bite set off a chemical
reaction with the spices inside its body,
causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type.

Une morsure de Kokiyas a déclenché
une réaction avec les épices,
rendant Flagadoss de type Poison.

original_text:
It uses the stalks of leeks that are
larger and thicker than usual, which
made them to adapt to a unique form.

It uses the stalks of leeks that are
larger and thicker than usual, which
made them to adapt to a unique form.

Il
utilise des poireaux plus grands
et épais, adaptés à cette forme.

original_text:
A Grimer, which had been brought in to
solve a problem with garbage, developed
over time into this form.

A Grimer, which had been brought in to
solve a problem with garbage, developed
over time into this form.

Un
Tadmorv amené pour gérer les déchets

original_text:
The garbage it eats causes continuous
chemical changes in its body, which
produce its vivid coloration.
spanish_text:
The garbage it eats causes continuous
chemical changes in its body, which
produce its vivid coloration.
translation:
Les déchets qu'il mange provoquent
des changements chimiques constants
qui donnent sa couleur vive.

original_text:
It swings its long neck like a whip and
smacks its opponents. This makes
Exeggutor itself dizzy, too.
spanish_text:
It swings its long neck like a whip and
smacks its opponents. This makes
Exeggutor itself dizzy, too.

Il
fouette ses ennemis avec son long
cou. Cela étourdit aussi Noadkoko.

original_text:
Its custom is to mourn its lost friends.
Mounds of dirt by the side of the road
mark the graves of the Marowak.
spanish_text:
Its custom is to mourn its lost friends.
Mounds of dirt by the side of the road
mark the graves of the Marowak.

Il pleure ses amis perdus.
Des tas de terre au bord des routes
marquent les tombes des Ossatueur.

original_text:
This Pokémon consumes particles that
contaminate the air. Instead of leaving
droppings, it expels clean air.
spanish_text:
This Pokémon consumes particles that
contaminate the air. Instead of leaving
droppings, it expels clean air.

Ce Pokémon avale les particules
qui polluent l'air. Au lieu de
déjections, il expulse de l'air pur.

original_text:
It can radiate chilliness from the

day tap dancing on a frozen floor.
spanish_text:
It can radiate chilliness from the
bottoms of its feet. It'll spend its
day tap dancing on a frozen floor.

Il diffuse le froid par la plante
des pieds. Il passe la journée
à claquer des pas sur la glace.

original_text:
Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires
beams that can immobilize opponents as
if they had been frozen solid.

Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires
beams that can immobilize opponents as
if they had been frozen solid.

Connu comme
Artikodin, ce Pokémon lance des
rayons qui figent les adversaires.

original_text:
One kick from its powerful legs will
pulverize a dump truck. It runs
through the mountains at over 180 mph.
spanish_text:
One kick from its powerful legs will
pulverize a dump truck. It runs
through the mountains at over 180 mph.

Un coup de ses puissantes
pattes pulvérise un camion. Il
court en montagne à plus de 180 mph.

original_text:

the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims
become burned-out shadows of themselves.
spanish_text:
Its sinister, flame-like aura consumes
the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims
become burned-out shadows of themselves.

Son aura sinistre enflammée consume
l'esprit de ses victimes. Elles
deviennent des ombres éteintes.

original_text:
While chanting strange spells, Slowking
combines its internal toxins with what
it's eaten, creating strange potions.
spanish_text:
While chanting strange spells, Slowking
combines its internal toxins with what
it's eaten, creating strange potions.

En psalmodiant, Roigada mélange
ses toxines internes à ce qu'il
a mangé, créant d'étranges potions.

original_text:

life force of others through its branches.

Sudden climate change wiped out this
ancient kind of Corsola. It absorbs the

Un changement climatique a éliminé
cet ancien Corayon. Il absorbe
la force vitale par ses branches.

original_text:
It moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc
upon its surroundings. It is thought to
be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.
spanish_text:
It moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc
upon its surroundings. It is thought to
be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.
translation:
Il se déplace en zigzag et sème le
chaos autour. On pense que c'est la
forme la plus ancienne de Zigzaton.

original_text:
It uses its long tongue to taunt foes.
Once the opposition is enraged, it
hurls itself, tackling them forcefully.
spanish_text:
It uses its long tongue to taunt foes.
Once the opposition is enraged, it
hurls itself, tackling them forcefully.
translation:
Il provoque avec sa longue
langue. Quand l'ennemi s'énerve,
il se jette sur lui violemment.

original_text:
They freeze their breath to make
snowballs, using them as ammo for
playful snowball fights.
spanish_text:
They freeze their breath to make
snowballs, using them as ammo for
playful snowball fights.
translation:
Ils gèlent leur souffle
pour faire des boules de neige,
munitions de batailles ludiques.

original_text:
Though it has a gentle disposition,
it's also very strong. It stashes food
in the snowball on its head.

Though it has a gentle disposition,
it's also very strong. It stashes food
in the snowball on its head.

Doux de nature mais
très fort, il cache de la nourriture

over as it rampages indiscriminately.

Sa colère a rallumé sa
poche de feu. Ce Pokémon crache des

original_text:

when an ancient clay tablet was drawn
to a vengeful spirit.

It's said that this Pokémon was formed
when an ancient clay tablet was drawn
to a vengeful spirit.

On dit qu'il
est né quand une tablette d'argile
antique a attiré un esprit vengeur.

original_text:

gets close, it will clamp down hard.
spanish_text:

Ses lèvres voyantes
attirent la proie dans la boue.
Quand elle approche, il mord fort.

form is skilled in close-range combat.

Né quand 10 % des cellules

original_text:

Ce Plumeline a bu du nectar rose.

Some dancers use its graceful, elegant
dancing as inspiration.
spanish_text:
This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar.

Ce Plumeline
a bu du nectar violet. Sa danse

who can draw out their true power.
spanish_text:

Ils vivent seuls sans former de
meute. Ils n'obéissent qu'à ceux qui

evolving at dusk. An intense fighting
spirit underlies its calmness.
spanish_text:
This strange form is the result of it
evolving at dusk. An intense fighting
spirit underlies its calmness.

Cette forme vient d'une évolution
au crépuscule. Un esprit combatif

When they team up to use Water Gun, its
power exceeds that of Hydro Pump.

À leur apparition,
même les Léviator fuient. Ensemble,
Pistolet à O dépasse Hydrocanon.

the power of Solgaleo, making it very
ferocious and impossible to control.

This is Necrozma while it's absorbing
the power of Solgaleo, making it very
ferocious and impossible to control.

Voici Necrozma lorsqu'il absorbe la
force de Solgaleo, le rendant très
féroce et impossible à contrôler.

original_text:

Now under the control of Necrozma, it
continuously expels all of its energy.
spanish_text:
Lunala no longer has a will of its own.
Now under the control of Necrozma, it
continuously expels all of its energy.

Lunala n'a plus de volonté.
Sous le contrôle de Necrozma,
elle expulse sans cesse son énergie.

original_text:

overwhelming light energy. It fires
laser beams from all over its body.

This is its form when it has absorbed
overwhelming light energy. It fires
laser beams from all over its body.

C'est sa forme après avoir absorbé

original_text:

was presented as a gift to royalty.

Il fonctionne grâce à une âme
artificielle. Sa décoration prouve

out the Arrokuda lodged in its throat.

The slightest shock is sometimes
enough to get this Pokémon to spit

Le
moindre choc lui fait recracher

Ce Nigosier a coincé
un Pikachu dans son gosier. Il

emplit les environs d'un son

Le tourbillon sur son corps est sa
faiblesse. S'il est remué, il perd
sa forme et titube.

tea causes strong chills if swallowed.

En colère, il envoie du thé dans la
bouche de l'agresseur. Avalé, ce thé
provoque de forts frissons.

La glace sur son visage
s'est brisée, révélant une mine

horns with each other to share
information between them.

horns with each other to share
information between them.

Ces
Pokémon intelligents touchent leurs
cornes pour partager des infos.

of violence. Until its hunger is appeased,
it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.
spanish_text:

of violence. Until its hunger is appeased,
it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

Une faim intense le rend violent.
Jusqu'à être rassasié, il se livre à
toutes sortes d'actes mauvais.

original_text:

ancient times, this Pokémon needs only
a single strike to fell any target.
spanish_text:
Now armed with a weapon it used in
ancient times, this Pokémon needs only
a single strike to fell any target.
translation:
Armé de l'arme qu'il maniait jadis,
ce Pokémon n'a besoin que d'un coup
pour abattre n'importe quelle cible.

original_text:

it can shrug off impressive blows,
even from Dynamaxed foes.

it can shrug off impressive blows,

Une fois son bouclier équipé, il
encaisse même les coups des

the surrounding space-time.

this Pokémon's enlarged core, warping
the surrounding space-time.

Une énergie infinie jaillit de son
noyau augmenté, déformant

Cette forme de Shifours croit dur

ennemis sous une pluie de coups.

Ce Zarude a quitté
sa meute pour élever un enfant

location overnight.

On dit qu'il a déplacé une grande
forêt vers un nouvel endroit en une

original_text:

this Pokémon saved the creatures
of a forest from a meteorite strike.

On dit que ce
Pokémon a sauvé les créatures d'une

original_text:

snowy mountains and defend themselves

snowy mountains and defend themselves

Ces Pokémon vivent en meute
dans les montagnes enneigées et

original_text:

back down to the mountain's base.

back down to the mountain's base.
translation:
Il guiderait les gens vertueux
égarés sur les sentiers de montagne
jusqu'au pied du mont.

original_text:
When excited, Voltorb discharges the
electric current it has stored in its
belly, then lets out a great laugh.
spanish_text:
When excited, Voltorb discharges the
electric current it has stored in its
belly, then lets out a great laugh.
translation:
Voltorbe libère le courant stocké
dans son ventre, puis éclate de
rire.

original_text:
When irritated, this Pokémon lets
loose an electric current equal to
20 lightning bolts.
spanish_text:
When irritated, this Pokémon lets
loose an electric current equal to
20 lightning bolts.
translation:
Agacé, ce Pokémon libère un courant
égal à 20 éclairs.

original_text:
It is said to purify lost, forsaken
souls with its flames and guide
them to the afterlife.
spanish_text:
It is said to purify lost, forsaken
souls with its flames and guide
them to the afterlife.
translation:
On dit qu'il purifie les âmes
perdues et abandonnées grâce à ses
flammes et les guide vers l'au-delà.

original_text:
Fisherman detest this troublesome
Pokémon because it sprays poison from
its spines, getting it everywhere.
spanish_text:
Fisherman detest this troublesome
Pokémon because it sprays poison from
its spines, getting it everywhere.
translation:
Les pêcheurs détestent ce Pokémon
ennuyeux car il asperge tout de
poison depuis ses épines.

original_text:
From the tips of its claws drips
a venom that infiltrates the nerves
of any prey caught in its grasp.
spanish_text:
From the tips of its claws drips
a venom that infiltrates the nerves
of any prey caught in its grasp.
translation:
Le bout de ses griffes goutte un
venin qui infiltre les nerfs de
toute proie qu'il attrape.

original_text:
Hard of heart and deft of blade,
its turbulent blows crash into foes
like ceaseless pounding waves.
spanish_text:
Hard of heart and deft of blade,
its turbulent blows crash into foes
like ceaseless pounding waves.
translation:
Dur de coeur et maître de la lame,
ses coups turbulents frappent les
ennemis comme des vagues sans fin.

original_text:
The leaves on its head are highly
valued for medicinal purposes when
dried in the sun and boiled.
spanish_text:
The leaves on its head are highly
valued for medicinal purposes when
dried in the sun and boiled.
translation:
Les feuilles sur sa tête sont très
prisées comme remède une fois
séchées et bouillies au soleil.

original_text:
This Basculin differs from others in
several respects, including its
demeanor - this one is gentle.
spanish_text:
This Basculin differs from others in
several respects, including its
demeanor - this one is gentle.
translation:
Ce Bargantua diffère par son
comportement : celui-ci est doux.

original_text:
A once-departed soul, returned to
life. It derives power from resentment,
which rises as energy atop its head.
spanish_text:
A once-departed soul, returned to
life. It derives power from resentment,
which rises as energy atop its head.
translation:
Âme revenue à la vie, il tire
sa puissance de la rancoeur devenue
énergie au-dessus de sa tête.

original_text:
Heedless of its own safety, it attacks
its nemeses with a bitter energy so
intense, it lacerates its own body.
spanish_text:
Heedless of its own safety, it attacks
its nemeses with a bitter energy so
intense, it lacerates its own body.
translation:
Sans souci de lui-même, il attaque
ses ennemis jurés d'une énergie
amère si intense qu'il se lacère.

original_text:
It is said to blast lakes with shock
waves, then scoops up any prey
that float to the water's surface.
spanish_text:
It is said to blast lakes with shock
waves, then scoops up any prey
that float to the water's surface.
translation:
On dit qu'il fait exploser les lacs
par ondes de choc, puis ramasse les
proies qui flottent à la surface.

original_text:
It is said its metallic shell developed
as a result of the mucus on its skin
reacting with the iron in ancient water.
spanish_text:
It is said its metallic shell developed
as a result of the mucus on its skin
reacting with the iron in ancient water.
translation:
On dit que sa coque métallique
vient du mucus de sa peau réagissant
au fer des eaux anciennes.

original_text:
Able to freely control the hardness
of its metallic shell. It loathes
solitude and is extremely clingy.
spanish_text:
Able to freely control the hardness
of its metallic shell. It loathes
solitude and is extremely clingy.
translation:
Il contrôle la dureté
de sa coque métallique. Il déteste
la solitude et est très collant.

original_text:
The armor of ice covering its lower
jaw puts steel to shame and can
shatter rocks with ease.
spanish_text:
The armor of ice covering its lower
jaw puts steel to shame and can
shatter rocks with ease.
translation:
L'armure de glace
de sa mâchoire inférieure ridiculise
l'acier et brise les rochers.

original_text:
The air stored inside the rachises of
Decidueye's feathers insulates the
Pokémon against extreme cold.
spanish_text:
The air stored inside the rachises of
Decidueye's feathers insulates the
Pokémon against extreme cold.
translation:
L'air stocké à l'intérieur des
rachis des plumes d'Archéduc isole
le Pokémon du froid extrême.
